newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia govt Sept jobs indicator falls.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia govt Sept jobs indicator falls.

text.p: The Australian government's leading indicator of employment fell to minus 0.514 in September from minus 0.418 in August, the Employment Department said on Wednesday.

"Although the rate of decline in cyclical employment has been moderating in recent months, the lack of a trough in the indicator suggests that employment is likely to grow at a relatively subdued pace for some time to come," the department said in a statement.
The indicator has fallen steadily every month since a slight rise in May.
The indicator comprises seven sets of figures, including official and private sector job vacancies data, housing approvals and vehicle registrations.
It has been shown to lead employment consistently over a long period.
